audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 3, 4 and 5 disagreed with packet.levelChart (Skill/Ziggs/Ziggs/Ziggs/Poppy/Ziggs/Ziggs) and with the whys. Level 6 in particular read Ziggs at 2/10 while whys[4] calls it 'your only stage you genuinely own'. The diff enum also read EVEN beside an 8.5/10 difficulty, a red tone and report[14] calling it a hard matchup.
audit.why: The one row where the text says Poppy wins was rendered as her worst row.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4, 5 flipped as matched full+content pairs with ratings updated; diff set to HARD to match diffRating, tone and report[14].

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and first-item whys were boilerplate that did not describe the actual spikes.
audit.why: Keeper's Verdict at 6 is the only Poppy swing; his first AP item plus Hexplosive Minefield and Satchel Charge close her E path again.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tldr, winCon and report[0]/[1] all promise 'your W deletes dashes' — Ziggs has no dash in his kit. Steadfast Presence has nothing to stop here. Trades also carried the 'his answer is down' placeholder and no cooldowns (packet flags zero sequencing cues).
audit.why: Telling a Poppy player her W counters his mobility invites her to hold a 20s cooldown for an event that never happens. The real timers are Satchel Charge (20/18/16/14/12s), Hexplosive Minefield (a flat 16s) and Bouncing Bomb (6s at rank 1), and Short Fuse's cooldown shortens with every ability he casts, so standing in poke range compounds.
audit.corrected: Dash-denial claim removed; W repositioned as resistances plus anti-diver tool; all engage advice keyed to Satchel Charge's 20s and the minefield's 16s.

audit.why: Satchel Charge carries a percentHealth derived flag, but Riot's description says only 'deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away' — no max-health component. Flag treated as a tooltip-parsing misfire and not asserted anywhere.

edits.before: Passive shield trades + Q zone control win early. Identify how Ziggs contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both weak at 1, but Bouncing Bomb already out-ranges you — the only reason this row is even is neither can commit.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Satchel Charge's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He widens it: your flat damage stops scaling while Bouncing Bomb (6s) and the minefield ramp. Farm under tower and wait for 6.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ziggs's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict is your one swing here — launch him out of position or peel the diver off you. The only stage you genuinely own.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Satchel Charge's cooldown.
edits.after: His first AP item plus Hexplosive Minefield and the Satchel knockback wall your E dash off entirely.

edits.before: His early — survive to your spikes. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: His lane except level 6 — survive to it, then flank. The chart shows the swing.

edits.before: He kites you out — survive, then wall-stun him on the Satchel Charge cooldown — your W deletes dashes. Poppy wins the Satchel Charge cooldown windows.
edits.after: He out-ranges everything you have — survive to 6, then flank and E him into a wall while Satchel Charge (20s) is down. W stops no dash he has.

edits.before: Wall-stun him on the Satchel Charge cooldown — your W deletes dashes. Track Satchel Charge before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Flank and wall-stun him inside Satchel Charge's 20 seconds. Q his max HP the instant the stun lands, and never walk into Hexplosive Minefield.

edits.before: E Ziggs into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E him into a wall while Satchel Charge (20s) is spent, Q the zone under him, and finish before Hexplosive Minefield (16s) lands.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Stepping into his minefield to reach him — the slow hands him a whole 6s Q rotation.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and knocks him clear of your combo — engage inside that window.

edits.before: E Ziggs into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s and slows you out of E range — commit after it is spent, then E him into terrain and Q.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Ziggs has no dash — W is for the diver and its resists for poke.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The stun is the whole trade; with no terrain E just shoves him to safety.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Save W's resistances and speed for the gank that actually kills you.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Short Fuse's cooldown drops on every ability he casts, so his poke ramps the longer you stand there.

edits.before: Track Ziggs's Satchel Charge: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — E wall-stun + Q burst.
edits.after: Satchel Charge (20s) knocks him clear and Hexplosive Minefield (16s) slows you out of E range. Flank when both are spent.

notes: The page told the user her W 'deletes dashes' in a matchup where Ziggs has no dash at all — removed, and W repositioned as the anti-diver and resistance tool. Satchel Charge carries a percentHealth derived flag that Riot's description does not support; not asserted. diff read EVEN against an 8.5/10 rating, a red tone and a report line saying 'Hard matchup' — proposed HARD; if that token is not in the enum the applier will reject just that one edit. dosFull[2].t still reads 'W his dash mid-flight', which is wrong, but at 21 characters it falls under the applier's 25-character skip and needs a manual fix.
